subject: Pending settlement: INV-2029-341 — remittance checklist & timing
body:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@cedarwave.com>
Cc: Maria Ortiz <maria.ortiz@cedarwave.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pending settlement: INV-2029-341 — remittance checklist & timing

Hi Alex / Maria,

Attached is invoice INV-2029-341 for the April usage window (line-item breakdown attached in Drive link below). Quick notes to help your AP team choose the fastest path:

- ACH (US): quickest net receipt, please send to the account on remit-instructions.docx; allow 2 business days for clearing.
- Wire: same-day if initiated before your bank cut-off; include invoice reference to speed reconciliation.
- Card: we can accept a virtual card but it will incur the processing fee noted on the invoice.

If you need us to accept payment to a different entity for VAT reasons, let me know — we can provide the W9 and a VAT summary for your tax team (attached).

Can you confirm preferred payment method and an expected payment date? If AP needs a single consolidated PDF for internal routing I can resend that.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: INV-2029-341.pdf (invoice), W9-redwood.pdf (tax form)
Related: https://drive.google.com/open?id=invoice_341_breakdown

----
From: Alex Nguyen <alex@cedarwave.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maria Ortiz <maria.ortiz@cedarwave.com>
Date: Mon, 13 May 2029 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pending settlement: INV-2029-341 — remittance checklist & timing

Thanks Naomi — looping in AP (Maria). Quick heads-up: our card on file declined when we attempted an authorization this morning (bank returned code: 51). AP is requesting:

1) A single-page invoice summary (PDF) with PO reference (PO# CW-2104).
2) W9 and confirmation of Redwood entity to remit to (for our tax team).
3) Can you confirm whether we can pay net-30 or will this trigger a late fee?

We can do wire but need beneficiary details and the bank cut-off to judge timing. If you can provide the wire routing now we can queue it with our bank.

Appreciate a quick response — we aim to settle this week.

Cheers,
Alex
Alex Nguyen
Head of Finance Operations
CedarWave Technologies

----
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@cedarwave.com>, Maria Ortiz <maria.ortiz@cedarwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pending settlement: INV-2029-341 — remittance checklist & timing

Hi Alex / Maria,

Thanks for the heads up. Answers below and next steps:

1) Single-page summary: attached and also uploaded to the Drive link. (See INV-2029-341-summary.pdf).
2) W9 attached (W9-redwood.pdf) — remit to Redwood Inference LLC unless your tax team instructs otherwise.
3) Payment terms: standard net-30 applies; we are not applying late fees for payments received within an additional 7-day courtesy window for this invoice (so EOM-week grace). Please note that early-pay discount lines do not apply retroactively.

Wire routing (beneficiary and bank reference) — please use remit-instructions.docx. Key items for your bank: include invoice ref INV-2029-341 and account reference RW-5689 so our AR team reconciles automatically.

Marissa — can you confirm whether we should open a short escrow option for this customer if the card retry fails again? Ben, flag if any pricing hold or credits to apply.

If you can confirm method by EOD tomorrow we’ll mark this as in-flight and prioritize reconciliation.

Best,
Naomi

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Alex Nguyen <alex@cedarwave.com>, Maria Ortiz <maria.ortiz@cedarwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pending settlement: INV-2029-341 — remittance checklist & timing

Hi Alex / Maria — quick update from our side: our payments team confirmed they received a queued wire from CedarWave this afternoon; expected ledger date with Redwood is 2029-05-17 (same day trace pending). I attached the payment acknowledgement stub from our bank for your records.

If anything lands as ACH instead of wire please reply-all so we can match immediately — that reduces manual reconciliation time. Once funds clear I’ll send a remittance confirmation email (with clearing reference).

Thanks for moving quickly here. If you want a one-time waiver on next month’s early-pay language while you sort card routing, we can discuss it with Revenue Ops — Ben and Naomi are on the thread.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Collections Lead, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: payment-ack-stub.pdf (bank reference pending)
DocuSign (service agreement amendment): https://app.docusign.com/doc/ABC123
